build_TransformerDecoder: build a TransformerDecoder with config, dictionary, and token embeddings for sequence-to-sequence decoding
build_TransformerDecoderBase_layer: build a single TransformerDecoderLayer with optional checkpointing and FSDP wrapping
run_TransformerDecoderBase_forward: run the decoder forward pass with encoder output and incremental state for autoregressive generation
run_TransformerDecoderBase_extract_featu: extract decoder features from input tokens and encoder output without applying the output projection layer
review_TransformerDecoderBase_upgrade_st: review the state dict upgrade logic for backward compatibility with older checkpoint versions
